office: the municipality, for the FPS Foreign Affairs

standard.within: delivered by the 5th working day after the day of application (municipality); about 2 weeks (embassy or consulate)

urgent.ready: the next working day if applied for before 15:00
within 4.5 hours if applied for Monday to Friday before 15:00

note: The amounts are what the municipality owes the FPS Foreign Affairs (an adult's includes a federal tax of 30 euros); a municipality may charge more on top. A 66-page passport is issued only in the urgent and very urgent procedures (and abroad, at 240 and 210 euros).

sources.title: Embassy of Belgium in Greece (FPS Foreign Affairs), Passport (last updated on June 24, 2026)
sources.said: Belgian passports are valid 7 years (5 years for minors). Any Belgian citizen can be issued his or her own passport starting at birth.
